title: Money Transfer Feature
description: As an authenticated customer, I want to transfer money to another account so that I can move funds without visiting a branch.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can choose a source account and destination account
Transfer completes within 3 seconds for valid requests
Balances update immediately after a successful transfer
Customer sees a clear error when funds are insufficient

comments.author: product_owner
comments.body: Happy path and insufficient-funds behavior are release blockers.

comments.author: qa_lead
comments.body: Prioritize validation around balance updates and duplicate submits.

linked_requirements.title: Authenticated customers can submit valid transfers
Insufficient funds are rejected without balance changes

title: Password Reset Flow
description: As a locked-out user, I want to reset my password using a verified email link so that I can regain access safely.
acceptance_criteria: Reset link is sent only to a registered email address
Reset link expires after 15 minutes
New password must satisfy the configured password policy
User can sign in with the new password after reset

linked_requirements.title: Password reset links expire after the configured window

title: Admin Refund Approval
description: As an operations manager, I want to approve high-value refund requests with audit tracking so that refund risk is controlled.
acceptance_criteria: Refunds above 1000 require manager approval
Approver cannot be the same user who created the request
Approved refunds create an audit entry with actor, timestamp, and amount
Rejected refunds keep the original payment unchanged

comments.author: risk_manager
comments.body: Audit trail evidence must include actor, timestamp, amount, and outcome.

linked_requirements.title: Refund decisions produce immutable audit records

title: Account Statement Export
description: As a customer, I want to export account statements as PDF and CSV files so that I can reconcile my records.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can choose a date range up to 24 months
PDF export includes opening balance, transactions, and closing balance
CSV export includes transaction date, description, debit, credit, and balance
Invalid date ranges show a validation message

comments.author: data_analyst
comments.body: CSV column order matters for downstream reconciliation imports.

linked_requirements.title: Customers can export statements for supported date ranges

title: Transfer Limit Validation
description: As a retail banking platform, I want to enforce daily transfer limits so that transactions stay within customer and regulatory controls.
acceptance_criteria: Transfers exceeding the daily customer limit are blocked
Customer sees remaining daily transfer allowance
Limit checks include completed transfers from the same calendar day
Internal users can view the blocked transfer reason

comments.author: compliance
comments.body: Daily limit reset timezone still needs confirmation.

linked_requirements.title: Daily transfer limit checks include completed transfers
